minutes_text:
ACTION MEMO
  PARKLANDS COMMITTEE
  JANUARY 12, 2015

Council Chambers  Monday
City Hall  January 12, 2015
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  7:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on
all appropriate items on Tuesday, January 27, 2015.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL  Members present: Chair Peterson, Rubincam, Wade, Kaviani
  & Chooljian - left the meeting at 9:20 p.m.

  Members absent: None

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC

None

CITIZEN APPLICATION

1.  PC-388-14; Application to remove 4 public trees located in the parkways adjacent
  to 941 and 944 Via Rincon

  Applicant:  David Lu
  949 Via Rincon
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Committee member Rubincam moved and Wade seconded to continue this
application to the next meeting. The vote was 5-0.

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, January 27, 2015.
  Directors initials SR-L
 2.  PC-389-15: Application to remove or reduce 1 Eucalyptus tree located in the
  parkway adjacent to 1100 Via Zumaya

  Applicant:  James Nyman
  2529 Via Olivera
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Committee member Kaviani moved and Chooljian seconded to approve
reduction of the Eucalyptus tree located adjacent to 1100 Via Zumaya by utilizing
crown reduction by approximately 8-feet. The vote was 3-2, Rubincam and Wade
dissenting.

3.  PC-390-15; Application to remove 4 Canary Island pine trees located in the
  parkway adjacent to 2225 and 2221Via Cerritos

  Applicant:  Johnson Chang
  2228 Via Cerritos
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Committee member Peterson moved and Chooljian seconded to continue
this application to allow the members to gain access to the property for the next
meeting. The vote was 5-0.

4.  PC-391-15; Application to remove 1 pine tree in the parkway located adjacent to
  1612 Chelsea Road

  Applicant:  Rick Marshall
  #86 Rocking Horse Road
  Rancho Palos Verdes, CA 90275

Action: Committee member Rubincam moved and Wade seconded to continue this
application to allow the applicant to provide additional information. The vote was
5-0.

5.  PC-392-15; Application to remove 2 Eucalyptus trees in the parkway located
  adjacent to 2336 Chelsea Road

  Applicant:  Sean Armstrong
  2333 Chelsea Road
  Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

Action: Committee member Chooljian moved and Wade seconded to deny removal
but approve the application with modification to allow reduction of the trees
utilizing crown reduction and allowing the applicant to treat the trees with an
approved pesticide. The vote was 5-0.

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, January 27, 2015.
  Directors initials SR-L
 OLD BUSINESS

6.  Discussion of Application Process for Proposed Changes Parklands in the
  Parklands

Action: The Committee discussed the item, provided direction and continued the
discussion to the next meeting.

NEW BUSINESS

None

ITEMS OF INFORMATION FROM THE COMMITTEE/STAFF

7.  Update on 2014 applications

Action: Reviewed and filed.

ADJOURNMENT

The meeting is adjourned to the next meeting of February 9, 2015.

 Actions taken by this Committee are advisory. The City Council will take action on all
  appropriate items on Tuesday, January 27, 2015.
  Directors initials SR-L
